description: Reads the plan's shared costs: recorded expenses and payments, each participant's balance and the suggested transfers to settle up, in the plan's currency. Use when the user asks who paid what or who owes whom.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character plan ID. Links without a plan ID (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/when) are unsaved local drafts and are not accepted.
